title: Genomic DNA Extraction from Sea Cucumber Body-Wall Tissue
author: Jihoon Jo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gk8buzw

steps.title: Dissect and rinse tissue
steps.instruction: Dissect about 3–5 g of sea cucumber body‑wall tissue, cut into small pieces with a razor blade, and rinse the pieces with autoclaved sea‑water to minimize bacterial contamination.

steps.title: Freeze and grind tissue
steps.instruction: Place the rinsed tissue pieces in a mortar, add liquid nitrogen, and grind to a fine powder.

steps.title: Lysis with CTAB buffer
steps.instruction: Transfer the ground tissue to a 35 mL centrifuge tube, add 10 mL pre‑heated CTAB lysis buffer, add Protease K, and incubate at 65 °C for 1 hour, gently inverting the tube every 5–10 minutes.

steps.title: Add phenol and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL phenol solution to the lysate and incubate at 65 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: First chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Perform a chloroform extraction and separate the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL chloroform and gently invert the tube at room temperature (RT) for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 10 minutes at RT.
Transfer the aqueous supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Second chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Repeat chloroform extraction to further purify the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL chloroform and gently invert at RT for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 10 minutes at RT.
Transfer the aqueous supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Precipitate DNA from the cleared aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of isopropanol to the supernatant.
Add 1/3 volume of 7.5 M ammonium acetate (or add ammonium acetate to 0.5 volume of the supernatant).
Gently mix the tube and incubate at –80 °C overnight.
Centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Do not touch the DNA pellet.

steps.title: Wash pellet with 70% ethanol
steps.instruction: Wash and dry the DNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 10 minutes at 4 °C; do not disturb the pellet.
Air‑dry the pellet for 10–20 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in TE buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve the dried DNA pellet in TE buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 1–2 mL TE buffer (10 mM Tris, 1 mM EDTA).
Heat the tube at 60 °C until the pellet is completely dissolved.
